source_policy: Primary filings and company IR first; current secondary sources only for market price and competitive context. Facts, estimates and opinions remain separated.

facts.claim: Q2 2026 subscription revenue was $3.877B (+24.5% YoY; +23% CC), total revenue $3.987B (+24%).
Q2 cRPO was $13.20B (+21% YoY; +21.5% CC) and total RPO $29.0B (+21%).
ServiceNow AI exceeded $1B annual contract value in Q2 2026; 658 customers had more than $5M ACV and 123 Q2 deals exceeded $1M net-new ACV.
Management said Q2 subscription revenue included stronger U.S. federal on-premise mix that accelerated some revenue from Q3 into Q2.
H1 2026 OCF was $2.257B vs $2.393B prior year; PPE purchases $255M vs $395M; business-combination cash spending $8.776B.
H1 2026 stock-based compensation was about $1.213B in operating reconciliation, 16% of revenue, up 25% YoY.

June cash was $2.503B, current marketable securities $2.161B and total liquid financial assets about $6.7B; debt principal about $7.6B including $2.1B commercial paper at 3.98% with 81-day weighted remaining term.
Armis was acquired for preliminary consideration of about $7.6B and Veza about $1.2B in 2026.
One U.S. federal channel partner/system integrator represented 13% of Q2 and H1 2026 total revenue and 12% of June accounts receivable; no historical collection concern was reported.
PwC reported ServiceNow maintained effective internal control over financial reporting as of Dec. 31, 2025.
ServiceNow reported a 98% renewal rate for 2025.
At Financial Analyst Day, management targeted $30B+ subscription revenue, 30% of ACV from AI, Rule of 60+ by 2030 and SBC below 10% of revenue by 2029.
ServiceNow AI Gateway relaunched Sept. 10 as a runtime enforcement layer for governing agent-to-MCP connections inside AI Control Tower.

On Sept. 8, software stocks including ServiceNow fell after OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, reflecting investor concern that stronger frontier agents could disrupt incumbent software services; this is market concern, not proof of ServiceNow displacement.
ServiceNow closed at $131.24 on Sept. 10, 2026 after the five-for-one split-adjusted history.

source_quality_notes: AI ACV, product adoption and long-term targets are company-reported operating metrics, not audited future cash flows.
Reuters competition evidence is used only as a current red-team signal; stock-price reaction is not evidence that moat shrinkage has occurred.
Investing.com is used only for the completed-session reference close; no provider market capitalization is used.
OCF-PPE and OCF-PPE-SBC are diagnostics, not automatically normalized owner FCF.
